excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607

Is the Fusaka meta EIP correct? We currently have TXCREATE and Creation transaction SFId there but I had the idea that those EIPs were supposed to be swapped for each other?

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: The final form only has one.  Once we hit all our devet-1 targets the contract 7698 will be formally withdrawn.  Hitting all the marks includes a working TXCREATE precompile.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: i.e. don't remove stuff until the replacement is working.

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Ah right that makes sense. (TXCREATE precompile you mean the evm creator contract?)
